INSERT INTO job_shard (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, run_id, job_type, shard_key, state, claim_epoch, retry_count, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{runId}, #{jobType}, #{shardKey}, 'READY', 0, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})
